description: Verbit sells a verbal intelligence and voice AI platform that combines automatic speech recognition with human transcribers to provide captioning, transcription, translation, audio description, dubbing and note taking services. Its customers are universities, enterprises, courts and media companies.
SuperMeat sells cultivated chicken meat, grown directly from animal cells, through its proprietary cultivated meat platform that food companies use to make products containing cultivated meat.

Upstream offers a cybersecurity and intelligence platform for physical AI, automotive and smart mobility systems. Its automotive cybersecurity and data management solutions are offered to companies that build and operate connected vehicles and fleets.

Dazz offers a unified security remediation platform that uses AI, automation, and root-cause analysis to help teams identify, prioritize, and fix vulnerabilities. Dazz sells its platform to security and engineering teams at enterprises.

Headway is a changelog service that lets companies publish product updates on a public changelog page, with a widget, Markdown editor, custom categories, and scheduled publishing. Its customers are app and web-app developers and product teams.

Pentera provides an exposure validation platform that tests security controls with AI-driven adversarial testing in production, confirms which exposures are exploitable, and supports remediation of them. Its customers are enterprise security teams.

TurboTenant offers rental property management software and services, including tenant screening, rent collection, lease agreements, maintenance requests, and accounting. It is built for landlords who want to manage their properties themselves.
Anzu.io sells an in-game advertising platform that lets brands place ads inside video games and measure the viewable impressions. Its customers are advertisers, agencies and game publishers.

description: Elenium builds self-service kiosks and bag drops that use intelligent automation to cut passenger queues at airports. Its customers are airlines and airports, which use the systems to give passengers faster self-service check-in.

AccuLynx is an all-in-one management platform that connects everyone in a business, from the field to the office, in real time. AccuLynx is sold to roofing contractors and roofing businesses, which it helps run their operations.

SimplePractice sells practice management software, an EHR, that helps practitioners handle admin work, scheduling, billing, and clinical care. Its software is sold to mental health and wellness professionals, including therapists.

description: Sedric is an AI-powered platform that reviews marketing, communications, and partner content against a company's policies and applies real-time guardrails to that content. Sedric is built for banks, fintechs, RIAs, and asset managers.

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that includes Superhuman Mail, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Go, an AI assistant that works in the tools people already use. Superhuman sells its tools to individuals and to enterprises.

Agnikul Cosmos designs and manufactures orbital-class launch vehicles powered by 3D-printed engines. The company offers custom payloads and private launches, giving customers their own dedicated launch for their satellites.

Malt is an integrated freelance management system (FMS) that centralizes and manages the entire independent talent lifecycle, including contract and project management and task-based payment. Malt is sold to businesses that work with freelancers.

description: Vertice is an intelligent procurement platform that uses agentic workflows and AI insights to automate purchasing work, from intake and approvals to invoice payment and SaaS purchasing. It is built for finance and procurement teams.

Chargebee provides revenue infrastructure, including subscription management, recurring billing, pricing, and usage-based monetization for AI and SaaS products. Its customers are AI, SaaS, and consumer subscription businesses.

description: Critical Start sells Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services that provide 24x7x365 monitoring, investigation, and response, combining AI-powered triage with human-led investigation. Critical Start serves organizations that need outsourced security operations.

Tesorion is a Dutch, independent cybersecurity service provider that offers managed security, consultancy, secure infrastructure and incident response, and its Tesorion Immunity product provides Network Access Control.

Adranos makes solid rocket motors and the ALITEC solid rocket fuel, a proprietary aluminum-lithium alloy propellant that can increase missile range by up to 40% while saving costs. Its customers are prime contractors that build missiles and launch vehicles.

Antheia uses a biosynthesis platform, built on engineered microbes, to produce biosynthetic pharmaceutical ingredients. Antheia's ingredients are made for pharmaceutical manufacturing, including ingredients for the opioid overdose treatment.
